Gasly loses Monaco GP podium spot to Hadjar after appeal

Pierre Gasly has been stripped of his third-place finish at the Monaco Grand Prix following an appeal. Isack Hadjar has been awarded the podium spot. The specific details of the appeal and the incident leading to Gasly's penalty were not provided in the coverage.
